name: Taifoon example 1b: check my tenant (with the saved key)

parameters.content:
## 1b · Check my tenant

Attach your **Taifoon Relayer API** credential (no key yet: run **1a**) to **Get My Tenant** and execute.

Out: tenant id, how it came (`via`), its keys (prefixes only) and the next step the layer suggests.

taifoon.description: Reads the tenant of the key saved in the Taifoon Relayer API credential: who it is, its keys, its next step and its own traffic.
